description.zh: 运动声源的波前被挤密或拉疏，给出前后方听者的频率、掠过曲线与马赫锥；源动、听者静止、静止介质的几何模型。
description.en: A moving source's wavefronts bunch up or stretch out, giving heard frequency ahead and behind, a pass-by curve and the Mach cone; a geometric model with moving source, still listener and still medium.

reason.zh: 运动源每个波前的圆心不同，叠起来前密后疏，间距决定听到的频率。
reason.en: Each wavefront of a moving source has a different centre, so the set is dense ahead and sparse behind, and the spacing sets the heard frequency.

label.en: Frequency changes with time in a pass-by

reason.zh: 车辆掠过的音调曲线是一个随时间变化的频率，适合用频谱/时频的视角读。
reason.en: The pitch curve of a pass-by is a frequency that varies in time, a natural subject for spectra and time–frequency reading.

label.en: Frequency is a basic property of a wave

reason.zh: 多普勒移动的是频率，傅里叶页把任意信号拆成频率。
reason.en: The Doppler effect shifts frequency, and the Fourier lesson splits any signal into frequencies.

title.zh: 为什么救护车驶过音调会变？
title.en: Why does an ambulance change pitch as it passes?
